preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output string contains only alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(int(s[i]) if s[i].isdigit() else 1 for i in range(len(s)) if not (i > 0 and s[i-1].isdigit()))
postconditions.description: The output length matches the total count of characters after applying numeric multipliers, ignoring consecutive numeric digits.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == s[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(len(s)) if s[j].isalpha() and (i // (int(s[k]) if s[k].isdigit() else 1) for k in range(len(s)) if s[k].isdigit() and (k == 0 or not s[k-1].isdigit()))[i])
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is derived from the corresponding alphabetic character in the input, repeated according to the preceding numeric multiplier (ignoring consecutive numeric digits).
An empty input string results in an empty output string.
